description: This file defines the EntityPermissionsForm class in Drupal, which manages permissions for configuration-defined bundles within the user module. It includes methods for constructing the form, retrieving permissions based on configuration dependencies, and access control logic.

classes.name: EntityPermissionsForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for managing permissions associated with configuration-defined bundles, extending UserPermissionsForm.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with necessary services and configuration.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: permissionsByProvider
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with the bundle, grouped by provider, based on configuration dependencies.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the permissions form for a specific bundle, loading the bundle entity if necessary.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to manage permissions for the bundle, deprecated in Drupal 11.1.0.
